description: 국가철도공단_EPMS_재난대책자료실 [railways and stations and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 국가철도공단EPMS재난대책자료실 데이터는 국가철도공단 각 지역본부에서 생산·관리하는 재난대책 관련 주요 문서를 기반으로 구축된 자료로, 자료 고유번호, 지역본부, 제목, 게시일,. The portal shows 2025-11-25 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
